items.headline: Tayven Jackson throws 4 TD passes, runs for TD in OT as UNT beats Tulsa 45-44
items.description: — Tayven Jackson threw a season-high four touchdown passes and added a 1-yard rushing TD in overtime, Jahiem White had 219 yards rushing and a touchdown, and North Texas beat Tulsa 45-44 on Thursday night in the American Conference opener for both teams.
